introduction: Washington TANF provides temporary cash support for eligible families. WorkFirst helps participants prepare for employment.
description: Washington TANF provides temporary cash support for eligible families. WorkFirst helps participants prepare for employment.

sections.who: Eligible circumstances include pregnancy or caring for a minor child. Income, resources and time limits apply; some children remain eligible while in qualifying school through age 18.
sections.get: Approved cash assistance supports family needs. A non-needy caregiver route may support eligible children.
sections.docs:
• Household, pregnancy or child details.
  • Income and resource evidence requested by DSHS.
sections.apply:
1. Apply

    Use Washington Connection or contact a Community Services Office.

  2. Complete the interview

    Call 877-501-2233 or attend in person, weekdays 8 a.m.–2 p.m.

  3. Discuss WorkFirst

    Review participation requirements and any barriers with the caseworker.
sections.after: Follow the assigned plan and review notices. Ask about an exemption or accommodation rather than missing a required activity.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using DSHS TANF and WorkFirst. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
